 Print This week marks the onset of Rama Ekadashi, paving the way for the joyous celebrations of Dhanteras and Diwali, symbolizing prosperity and light. With Venus entering a retrograde phase in Virgo on November 6, financial decisions may require extra caution. While there are no favorable dates for marriage or housewarming, the same day presents a golden chance for buying a new vehicle, enhancing the festive ambiance leading up to Diwali. This week starts with Rama Ekadashi, a day of fasting and prayer for many families. After that, the mood shifts to wealth and light. Dhanteras comes on Friday, and Diwali is on Sunday, November 8. Venus moves back into Virgo on November 6 while it is retrograde. So be a little more careful with money, comforts at home, the standard of your work and your everyday habits. Watch 3 Powerful Ways to Attract Anything | Manifest Like a Sage Explained | Ajay Mishra Good Muhurta dates are hard to find this week. Weddings and Griha Pravesh have no suitable day, and property buyers will also have to hold off. But Friday, November 6, gives a good window for bringing home a new vehicle. All timings are given in Indian Standard Time for New Delhi. Shubh Muhurat This Week 
 A Shubh Muhurat is worked out by checking five things together: Tithi, Nakshatra, weekday, Yoga and Karana. The position of planets for that specific task is also taken into account. A festival day does not automatically suit every important step. Weddings follow their own conditions. So do house moves and vehicle purchases. Vivah Muhurat There is no marriage Muhurat in this week. Griha Pravesh Muhurat From November 2 to 8, no date is fit for Griha Pravesh. Property Purchase Muhurat Buying property is best avoided this week, as no auspicious window is available. Vehicle Purchase Muhurat This Week Just one slot is good for buying a vehicle. It begins on Friday, November 6, at 10:30 AM and lasts until 06:37 AM on Saturday, November 7. Planetary Events This Week 
 Venus is the only planet changing sign this week. It enters Virgo on Friday, November 6, at 12:45 AM. Virgo is where Venus is debilitated, and on top of that the planet is retrograde. So any plan to spend on expensive or luxury items deserves a pause. In relationships, simple and honest talk will work better than big shows of affection. And small slips, like a forgotten EMI date or a bill left unpaid, may come to light now. Festivals and Important Observances This Week 
 The Diwali week holds great religious importance all over India. Rama Ekadashi falls on Thursday, November 5. It is Kartika Krishna Ekadashi, and devotees keep a fast and worship Lord Vishnu. The fast is opened the next morning on Dwadashi. Dhanteras is on Friday, November 6, on Kartika Krishna Trayodashi. It marks the start of the five-day Diwali festival. People have bought gold and silver on this day for generations. And since the vehicle Muhurat also falls on Friday, it is the best day of the week for shopping and big purchases. Diwali comes on Sunday, November 8. Lakshmi Puja is done on Kartika Krishna Amavasya, the darkest night of the lunar month. Understanding This Week’s Panchanga 
 The Panchanga reads each day through five parts, called Vaara, Tithi, Nakshatra, Yoga and Karana. The way these five line up tells whether a day is right for a ritual or for starting something new. This week falls in the last part of Krishna Paksha. Ekadashi arrives on Thursday and Amavasya on Sunday. A waning Moon is usually seen as less supportive for fresh starts. Lord Vishnu is also still in his Chaturmas rest, which ends on Devuthani Ekadashi later in November. That is the main reason there are no dates for weddings or housewarmings. Vehicle buyers are the only ones in luck, as Friday is strong on both the religious side and the Muhurta side.
